terra.problem: By the seventh month the Israelites had settled in their towns; the verses do not say the altar had been built by then.
The verses say the foundation had not been laid when offerings began on the first day of the seventh month; they do not explicitly say it remained unlaid during the feast.
The verses say they gave provisions to the people of Sidon and Tyre, not that they sent them to those places.
The sound heard from afar was the noise of the people's shouts and weeping, not specifically the priests' and Levites' praise.
